_comment: SmartCuff GUI update manifest. Fetched by the installed GUI over plain
public HTTPS -- there is deliberately NO credential in the client. See
README.md for why an embedded token was rejected.
This file is the ONLY thing the updater needs to read. Keep it small and
keep it valid JSON: a malformed manifest must fail soft in the client, but
there is no reason to rely on that.
The installer is a GitHub Release asset rather than a repository blob.
Keep installer_url version-specific: an existing manifest must always
resolve to the exact immutable bytes whose size and SHA-256 it declares.
notes:
Application v3.1.371 / firmware rev27v-followup-348, release date 11/10/2026.

Smart Const and High Max refill and hold 5 mmHg above the accepted oscillation-envelope peak. Smart Const caps the final hold at 130 mmHg; High Max caps it at 140. Rejected analyses remain 80. The offset is applied once. The peak detector, quality thresholds, analysis deadline, PID and calibration are unchanged. GUI and standalone use the same firmware START runner.

The HTML manual and GUI summaries match this rule, and the detailed LED table now matches firmware347's RUN behavior. Boot/menu/fault RUN flashes remain disabled; the calculation circles still advance left to right.

The attached MATLAB ZIP contains smart_const_offline, every helper, START_HERE and a quick guide. It includes High Max protocol selection and fixes native MATLAB empty-struct initialization and numerical-roundoff outlier selection. Native MATLAB is not a numerical/deadline clone of the faster Due implementation. The requested +5 hold offset has not been shown to maximize human PVR amplitude.

Validation: 212 focused numerical/GUI/HTML/uploader checks, five-preset parity, clean layout audit, GUI smoke, six MATLAB R2026a test groups and an independently extracted MATLAB package pass. Firmware compiles at 216776 bytes. Protected snapshot/flash/restore verified device C calibration, valve limits, feedforward and PID.

Ten-minute seed213 soak: **100% delivery (27363/27363 frames)**.

| Cycle | Preset | Measured slope | Command | Control verdict |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| 1 | smart const | 3.69 | 4.00 | PASS |
| 2 | arm cvp | 0.93 | 1.00 | PASS |
| 3 | smart const | 3.64 | 4.00 | PASS |
| 4 | wrist cvp | 0.97 | 1.00 | PASS |
| 5 | regular | 3.62 | 4.00 | PASS |
| 6 | high max | 3.60 | 4.00 | PASS |

Slopes are mmHg/s. Non-CVP uses 150-40 mmHg; CVP uses the full ramp. PASS is the reversal/monotonicity verdict, not exact commanded-slope tracking.

Actual GUI-runner/firmware START checks:

- smart: peak 97.8, final hold 102.80 mmHg; calculation 7.778 s; 100% sequence delivery; control PASS.
- high: peak 135.37, final hold 140.00 mmHg; calculation 6.929 s; 100% sequence delivery; control PASS.
- fallback: peak None, final hold 80.00 mmHg; calculation 1.759 s; 100% sequence delivery; control PASS.

The clean numerical probe returned peak 75.006 / target 80.006 in 7.471 s; STOP cancelled the second analysis. Accepted and fallback OLED frames retain left-to-right completion.

Retained human replay: 2642/3024 accepted, 382 fallback. Among 2825 screened references, accepted peak bias/SD stays +5.725/8.010 mmHg (2480 accepted). Reprojecting the same decisions to peak+5 gives Smart Const final-hold MAE 11.323 mmHg including fallback; High Max 11.348. These are reused development recordings, not independent clinical validation or a new on-device replay of all human data. Previous peak and unoffset-target accuracy must not be labelled as current hold-target accuracy.

The installer is unsigned under the existing operator authorization. On a first install, use More info -> Run anyway if Windows SmartScreen asks. The verified Default feed delivers the complete application; calibration remains protected by the existing flash transaction.

Installer: 224243765 bytes; SHA-256 `fa6e78028cdd44c7b7cb3f1a79f39999613336a5abd193a5d3dd418004ec3fd0`; built 2026-11-10T18:23:31.6909800Z.

One fallback simulator-setup attempt was rejected while the simulator was in LOCAL mode, before the cuff run began. Its command trace is retained separately; the corrected pulses-off run is the scored fallback check.
